IT Infrastructure Engineer (Full-Time / Remote)

We are looking for an experienced IT Infrastructure Engineer to manage, maintain, and improve our company's IT systems, networks, and infrastructure.

What You'll Do

  • Manage and maintain IT infrastructure, servers, and networks.

  • Monitor system performance, security, and reliability.

  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, hardware, and network issues.

  • Manage access controls, backups, and system configurations.

  • Support infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and improvements.

  • Ensure systems remain secure, scalable, and operational.

Must Have

  • 4+ years of IT infrastructure or systems administration experience.

  • Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux environments.

  • Experience with networking (TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, firewalls).

  • Experience managing servers, virtualization, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and access management.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Nice to Have

  • AWS, Azure, DigitalOcean or other cloud platform experience.

  • Infrastructure automation and scripting (PowerShell, Bash).

  • Experience with monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery systems.

  • Experience supporting high-availability environments.

We're looking for someone hands-on who can take ownership of our IT infrastructure and keep our systems secure, reliable, and efficient.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bluegeko-it-infrastructure-engineer
